null_means: not established by the reviewed sources, not zero
evidence_rules: Dates, denominators and source scopes must remain attached to values.
Historical surveys are provisional model inputs, not measured 2026 population shares.
Preference percentages are not dish sales or meal shares.
Diet, allergy, nationality and athletics categories overlap; do not add them into disjoint student groups.
Nationality, ethnicity and country of origin do not determine individual taste or religious diet. Use voluntarily supplied food preferences and restrictions.
An absent allergen label does not establish absence of cross-contact.
Event effects on demand remain hypotheses until estimated from observed service counts.
null means not established, not zero.

candidate_model_features.treatment: Filter by explicitly supplied restrictions before ranking dishes.
Use actual menus and availability; cuisine categories may overlap.
Plausible decision factors; campus-specific coefficients must be measured.
Plans determine which alternatives are affordable and convenient; do not treat menu price as the only cost.
Collect voluntarily or estimate from consented feedback and aggregate observations.
Self-reported preferences rather than demographic assumptions.
Estimate effects using dated service records and avoid invented percentage lifts.
